sar.helicopter_work_policy: English2026 PDF137/14-11 requires a hovering helicopter. The existing fitted TS flight state, positive fueled Low-or-below altitude and admitted Hover throttle establish eligibility. Explicit RTS mapping:180 continuous eligible seconds at the actual declared station, resetting when ineligible; manual and automatic share one work balance and per-Tac allowance. A generic stationary aircraft or old remote order age grants no hoist progress. Station radius and capacity remain explicit scenario author inputs.

rts_policies.resolved_critical_receipt: A newly resolved expanded physical casualty emits the existing own-side CriticalHit receipt as well as its private detailed audit. A pending, absent or already-destroyed component never fabricates that receipt; no new die or physical effect is added.
rts_policies.battery_damage: each D6*5% loss is measured against original source maximum capacity; cumulative losses cap at original max; charged/depleted cells shrink proportionally
rts_policies.critical_identity: private original source identity; owner-visible IDs are unit-local opaque aliases
rts_policies.optional_modes: all optional flags off unless explicit source scenario config; CaS replaces pre-1955 surface table only
rts_policies.same_physical_system_rehit: preserve earlier dice/history, invalidate uncompleted repair session and require explicit new post-battle declaration; no quiet timer
rts_policies.manual_repair: automatic assistance optional; original due-time HP ratio snapshots persist when player delays rolling
rts_policies.rounding: retain fractional losses/rates unless source explicitly requires integer physical item counts; counts truncated only at actual removed objects; no light-caliber61-65 extension over English57-60 without explicit source
rts_policies.hull_depth_risk: When an order chooses to remain below the source safe band, one originalD100 per Tactical Turn; no second-by-second reroll and no risk merely for obeying the mandatory ascent.
rts_policies.rescue_geometry: Recovery station reach must be an explicit scenario_assumption fit, not an inferred hardware number. Direction candidates must be source/scenario geographic admissible headings; random choice is recorded.
rts_policies.survivor_boundaries: Printed30 and100 endpoints overlap adjacent source classes; no automatic profile or native scan is selected at those exact counts. Integer persons floor only after source percentage.
rts_policies.alongside_survivors: Increase survivor count by20percent (multiply1.2), not add20percentage points of original crew.
rts_policies.patch: Recorded actual floodingDP only, recover half after explicit post-battle declaration; a popped aggregate unit patch restores thoseDP and original tracked flooding severity. This is an explicit aggregate continuous-time patch policy.
rts_policies.weapon_expenditure: Native expenditure allocates to explicit ready physical component IDs in deterministic order; source original ammo distribution never inferred by dividing aggregate ammo.
rts_policies.sar_ship_continuity: Explicit continuous-time RTS mapping of per-Tactical-Turn ship work: only a live actual surface ship, stationary within the declared source/scenario recovery station and upwind, earns continuous work. One180-second eligible interval earns at most one recovery attempt; invalid station time resets work, time away never banks, manual waiting cannot accumulate multiple attempts, and actual recovery (including zero people from sea-state subtraction) consumes one interval. This second-by-second mapping is not verbatim Harpoon text. Other rescue platform work mappings remain separate.
rts_policies.sar_old_reports: An own survivor measurement remains a snapshot; no current private position fallback or live refresh when source current geography is unknown. Its recorded side, rather than a later present/dead observer lookup, governs durable ownership once explicitly recorded.
rts_policies.optional_repair_gate: Manual and automatic breakdown/airframe repair require the same actual post-battle session, no renewed own combat/pending or active fire/flooding.
rts_policies.aircraft_rehit_repair: An actual new aircraft hit archives earlier repair checks and requires a new explicit battle-end declaration; old elapsed checkpoints never repair a new casualty.
rts_policies.catastrophic_loss: Actual belowdecks or main-magazine instantaneous destruction and qualified nuclear lethal effects retain a private catastrophic cause until native loss; ordinary sink cannot replace D6% with D6*10%.
rts_policies.sar_witness: A real installed Visual lookout must successfully scan the original living platform in the current or immediately preceding one-second simulation phase, then pass the same source detector again at actual native loss. That measured loss position creates a durable side-owned survivor marker without a second survivor-size search. This phase-freshness mapping is explicit RTS policy, not a printed time limit. Friendly and enemy losses are eligible; stale Contacts, radar and current private survivor positions never substitute for visual evidence.
rts_policies.sar_victory: 14.8 prints no universal reward. Only actual committed pickups increment durable per-side rescue counts; an explicit scenario/source rescue_victory.points_per_survivor sets the additive reward. Absent a reward declaration the points are zero. This explicit pickup-time scoring policy does not assert later rescued-person attrition or campaign accounting.
